shots.name: Inner Loop

shots.name: Upper Loop / Loop Ramp

goals.title: Game Style Select (Attract-Mode Menu)

Keep holding until the menu appears on the display
Choose the mode you want, then start your game
Standard is the normal ruleset; Competition is the same game with random elements removed
Challenge is a modified, easier version of Black Order Battle Royale
DJ Mixer is a jukebox and does not affect scoring
goals.reward: Switches the game into Competition, Challenge (an easier version of Black Order Battle Royale), or DJ Mixer instead of Standard rules

goals.title: Placing Your Infinity Gems
goals.summary: Winning a Gem Quest is only half the work. The gem then has to be parked on a playfield shot, and where you park it decides what it is worth, because a gem draws its strength from how far along the Avenger holding it is. Park badly and you get a shrug. Park well and one shot carries the whole game.
instructions: Finish a Gem Quest, then shoot the right ramp once Collect Gem lights there.
Shoot one of the flashing gem shots to give the gem a home. This comes before everything else - the disc will not bank S-T-R-A-N-G-E letters toward the next quest until the gem is placed.

Watch who is holding it. Gem strength climbs a four-step ladder set by the Avenger underneath: not yet collected, collected, level 1, level 2. Keep shooting that Avenger's shot to climb it. An Avenger who reaches level 2 also doubles scoring on their own shot.

Reality Gem: multiplies scoring on the shot it sits on. 2x on an uncollected or collected Avenger, 3x at level 1, 4x at level 2. The 4x takes the place of the plain 2x a level 2 Avenger already carries rather than stacking with it.

Time Gem: shooting its shot adds 5 seconds to the master timer, 8 at level 1, 15 at level 2, and banks that time for later if no timed mode is running. Multiball ball saves stretch by the same amounts.

Mind Gem: its shot arms the action button to spot shots for you. On an uncollected Avenger it spots only the shot it sits on, once. Collected gives two of those. At level 1 you hold three uses that spot a lit shot anywhere on the playfield. At level 2 a single press sweeps every lit shot from left to right.
Recharge a spent Mind or Space Gem by leveling the Avenger holding it or by moving the gem to a new shot.

Space Gem: shooting its own shot lights the action button for three seconds and slides every placed gem along the playfield as one group, left to right, wrapping from the far right back around to the far left.

Change Gems lights once you have assembled the Avengers, and also turns up among the computer grid and mystery awards. Rotate positions with the flippers and lock each gem in with the action button - holding the Space Gem stretches that window to 20 seconds.
goals.reward: Each placed gem gives an ongoing perk on the shot it sits on, at full strength on a level 2 Avenger

goals.title: The Power Gem's Memory
goals.summary: Rank on an Avenger is a fragile thing. The Power Gem is the answer to that: park it on a hero and that hero climbs twice as fast and, more importantly, remembers where they got to after the ball is gone.
instructions: Win the Power Gem quest, then take Collect Gem at the right ramp like any other gem.
Place it on the Avenger shot you most want to build. Every shot toward leveling that Avenger counts double for as long as the gem sits there.
Keep feeding that shot. The level you reach, along with the doubled shot scoring that comes with level 2, carries into the next ball instead of being wiped by the drain.
The same memory covers a mini-wizard mode. When the assemble ladder resets after one, the Avenger holding this gem keeps their rank.
Different plan, same gem: put it on the Captain Marvel shot instead and every ramp or spinner hit counts double toward the next count-up award.
goals.reward: Double level-up progress on one Avenger, and that Avenger's rank surviving a drain

drills.title: Crest And Roll Back
drills.text: Plunge just hard enough that the ball crests the upper loop and rolls back down it. That single plunge pays points, the longest ball save on offer and a free Portal Lock, which is the multiplier every gem quest wants.

drills.title: Widow Into Marvel
drills.text: Loop the left ramp into Captain Marvel and back, over and over. They are the two safest shots on the machine and the combo counter does not care how pretty the chain is, only that it never stops.

drills.title: Gauntlet Ramp From Everywhere
drills.text: The Gauntlet ramp is makeable from every flipper on the machine, which is exactly why it is the shot you reach for under pressure. Drill it from both lower flippers until the brick rate drops, because a brick rejects straight back down the middle.

drills.title: Tower Only From A Cradle
drills.text: Take Avengers Tower with the ball settled, never on the fly. A bricked Tower shot drains, and this is the hole where super jackpots and the final blow on Thanos are collected, so the habit has to be built before it matters.

drills.title: Right Inlane, Then Spin
drills.text: Roll the right inlane first, then go to the disc. That roll lights the Eye of Agamotto so each spin advances STRANGE at double speed, and re-spelling STRANGE quickly is what lets you run several quests in one game.

drills.title: Eight Shots, Fixed Order
drills.text: Rehearse the sequence away from the mode: right orbit, left ramp, right ramp, left orbit, Thor's captive ball, the drop targets, Captain Marvel, Tower. A miss costs a flip rather than time, so speed buys you nothing and a memorised order buys you everything.

actionButton.label: Action Button
actionButton.how: This is the gem interface. Placed gems hand the button real powers — spotting shots for you, sliding your gems around the playfield — and holding it is how you gamble the Soul Gem for a second bite at a multiball.

uses.what: Flippers scroll the quests; the button, or both flippers at once, locks your choice in.

uses.when: Mind Gem placed on a shot
uses.what: Press to collect lit shots for you; at level 2 a single press takes every lit shot in every running mode.

uses.when: Right after the Space Gem shot
uses.what: You get 3 seconds — each press slides every placed gem one shot to the right, wrapping around the playfield.
Flippers rotate the positions and the button locks each gem down; the window stretches to 20 seconds if you hold the Space Gem.

uses.when: Black Order Multiball with the Soul Gem
uses.what: Hold it to restart the multiball when you drain to one ball — miss the super jackpot and the gem is gone.
Hold through it for Hard Mode: 20 flips instead of 30, but ten times the scoring.

howItPlays.objective: Avengers: Infinity Quest is a race for the six Infinity Gems before Thanos claims them. Win Gem Quests and park each gem on the right hero, farm combos into Portal Locks for tripled quest scoring, assemble the team, and take Thanos at the Tower.
loop: Spin the Eye of Agamotto disc to spell S-T-R-A-N-G-E, then shoot the Right Ramp to open mode select and start a Gem Quest.
Farm the safe Left Ramp and Captain Marvel loop to bank Portal Locks, then begin a quest with balls in play so it scores at two or three times.
Win the quest, take Collect Gem at the Right Ramp, and place the gem on a hero -- its strength climbs as you level that Avenger's shot.
Attempt all six quests and play the three mini-wizards to qualify Battle Thanos at the Tower, and bank twenty-four trophies to open the hidden Trophy Mania.

lights.name: STRANGE Disc
lights.lit: Spinning the Eye of Agamotto disc spells S-T-R-A-N-G-E, and the letters hold until the word is done, which qualifies your next Gem Quest and lights the Sanctum target for its final blow.
lights.then: Roll the Right Inlane before you go to the disc -- it lights the Eye so each spin advances STRANGE at double speed -- then re-spell fast between quests to bank several gems in a single game.

lights.name: Gem Quest Select
lights.lit: With STRANGE spelled, the Right Ramp lights to open Gem Quest select, and the quest inserts stay lit as choices until you commit to one.

control.effect: the flippers scroll through the available Gem Quests and the action button, or both flippers together, locks in your choice, so you can pick the quest that matches your strongest shot
control.when: at the Right Ramp mode-select screen

lights.then: Choose a quest, work its shots across three rounds, and always take the Final Blow at the lit Sanctum or the quest's finish shot to bank the gem; a quest is untimed and ends only when you drain, but a lost one leaves the gem with Thanos.

lights.name: Portal Locks & Combo Counter
lights.lit: The cumulative combo counter climbs as you loop the safe Left Ramp and Captain Marvel; four combos light the first Portal Lock, ten the second, and banked locks hold as your quest multiplier.
lights.then: Bank both Portal Locks, then open a Gem Quest while balls are still loose so it runs at triple value -- that boost lasts only as long as you keep a multiball alive, so close the quest out before you are back to one ball.

lights.name: THOR Captive Ball
lights.lit: Each captive-ball hit adds a letter to T-H-O-R -- the T and H come pre-spotted, so a pair of hits completes the word and the next one launches the multiball -- making it the safest lit shot on the machine.
lights.then: Start Thor Multiball, light all shots for jackpots, and collect the Super Jackpot at the Tower; spell THOR four times across the game and that super is worth twenty times plus a trophy.

lights.name: I-R-O-N Return Lanes
lights.lit: The two inlanes and two outlanes carry the I-R-O-N letters, and the right inlane also lights the Eye of Agamotto whenever you roll through it.
lights.then: For Iron Man Multiball you advance I-R-O-N by SPINNING the Eye disc, not by tapping the flippers across the lanes, then lock three balls at the Tower and work the phased jackpots up to a Tower super.

lights.name: Avengers Assemble & Gem Placement
lights.lit: Each hero levels at their own shot -- Black Widow on the Left Ramp, Hulk on the Left Orbit spinner, Captain America in the pops, Black Panther on the Right Orbit -- and a leveled hero's insert stays lit, carrying that rank until a mini-wizard resets the ladder.

control.effect: placed gems arm the button: a Mind Gem on a hero lets a press spot lit shots for you (at level two a single press sweeps every lit shot left to right), while shooting a Space Gem's shot lights the button to slide all your placed gems one shot to the right
control.when: a Mind or Space Gem is placed on a hero shot

lights.then: Finish an Assemble round to bank hero perks and disc multipliers, and complete all six a second time to light the Black Order mini-wizard; place each won gem on your highest-level hero, since a gem draws its strength from whoever is holding it.

lights.name: Battle Thanos Progress
lights.lit: Progress inserts track the six Gem Quests attempted and the three mini-wizards -- Soul Gem, Black Order Multiball, Black Order Battle Royale -- and each stays lit once it is cleared.
lights.flashing: The Tower flashes for Battle Thanos once every quest is attempted and every mini-wizard played.
lights.then: You only have to ATTEMPT all six quests, not win them, to qualify; spin the disc to rotate the damage colors and defeat Thanos at the Tower for six-ball Super Victory Laps, or walk in holding all six gems and it auto-completes for a billion-point bonus.

lights.name: Bonus X & Computer Grid
lights.lit: Shots up the pop-bumper lane step the end-of-ball Bonus multiplier, while the lower-left drop bank fills the Computer Grid, whose lit square roves on its own until you knock a drop down where you want it.
lights.then: Complete a grid three-in-a-row for awards like a Super mode or a jump in Bonus, and push the multiplier toward its twenty-five-times ceiling; a Mystery can Hold Bonus X so it survives the drain instead of resetting.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: There is no lane change here: the I-R-O-N letters on the return lanes only shift when the disc spins, never from a flipper tap, and the lone top rollover by the pops is a plunge-only skill-shot target.

scoring.text: Take the rollback skill shot -- a medium plunge that just crests the Upper Loop and rolls back for points, the longest ball save on offer, and a free Portal Lock, the multiplier every quest wants. Ready Thor at the captive ball and start looping the safe Left Ramp toward two Portal Locks.

Spell STRANGE on the disc, bank two Portal Locks for triple scoring, and start a Gem Quest with a multiball live so every quest shot scores tripled. Win the quest, park its gem on your best hero, and cash Victory Laps before the balls drain.

Attempt all six Gem Quests and play the three mini-wizards to light Battle Thanos at the Tower -- a four-ball fight paying six-ball Super Victory Laps, or an automatic billion if you arrive holding all six gems. Bank twenty-four of the thirty-two trophies across the game to open the hidden final mode, Trophy Mania.
